question: Что такое Request bodies и как это работает?
short_answer: A request body carries structured input; FastAPI commonly validates JSON through a Pydantic model.
junior_answer: A request body carries structured input; FastAPI commonly validates JSON through a Pydantic model. Body bytes are decoded by media type, parsed as JSON and validated recursively before the endpoint receives a typed model. Важное ограничение: Schema validation handles shape/ranges; database-dependent business invariants belong in service logic/constraints.
follow_up_question: Какая типичная ошибка связана с Request bodies?
follow_up_answer: Using a raw dict everywhere loses generated schema, typed access and precise field errors.
